ops.title: Guides workflow loses push races: cc-guides retry loop needs backoff or a concurrency group
ops.description: The `guides / render` job (cc-guides ci-render) commits re-rendered fragments back to main with 3 push retries spanning ~2.6s and no backoff. Any push to main while a Guides run is queued/mid-flight makes it fail with "could not land the re-render after 3 attempts" — reproduced identically on e7c2323 and 9fc6e7b (runs 30151768181, 30152055300) during the 2026-07-25 viz perf work, where a ~10min runner-queue delay guaranteed the race. Fix belongs in cc-guides or the rendered guides.yml, not cc-notes code: either a `concurrency: group: guides-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true` on the workflow, or fetch-before-retry with real backoff in cc-guides' push loop.

ops.text: Two rapid successive pushes to main both end with a green or superseded-cancelled Guides run — no 'could not land the re-render' failure
